question: Does increasing GPT-125M micro-batch from 64 to 128 provide meaningful throughput gains relative to memory cost?
prediction: Original preregistered prediction: 1.1M tok/s and 42% MFU. Revised expectation after M1-008: 775K-800K tok/s, with diminishing throughput gains and significantly higher peak memory.
